questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or steep downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the fastest legal speed allowed on the road. During bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be prepared to stop for a red light or to slow down for a yellow light, and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When other vehicles are entering your roadway, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they cannot park in this area. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: At a Yield sign, slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles pass first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means when you turn left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to enter the road. It is posted at the end of one-way streets to warn drivers not to go the wrong way. When you see this sign, stop and turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This will cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals always have red on top and green on bottom when arranged vertically. When arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign used with a traffic signal tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the road ahead curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign on a yellow panel means the lane will exit the highway. If you are in this lane, you can change lanes to continue through the interchange, or you must exit the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer may cross the road ahead. Slow down and stay alert so you can stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a curve is coming ahead in the direction of the arrow. The recommended safe speed for the curve is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you see it. Always let trains pass first because trains cannot stop for cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum speed you are allowed to drive on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black symbols. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you a traffic rule you must follow. It warns you not to block the intersection at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead makes a sharp turn in the direction of the arrow. Slow down before the turn just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.
